executiveSummary.title: WHAT THE DATA SAYS
executiveSummary.narrative:
The Westin Grand München appeared in at least one AI answer for 50% of the traveler needs we tested, showing that AI recognizes the hotel as relevant across a broad range of stays. Across every individual AI answer, however, The Westin Grand München appeared 32.8% of the time. In practical terms, the hotel fits many of the searches being made, but a traveler will not consistently see The Westin Grand München in the hotel options surfaced.

The clearest strength in this period is often placed near the top when ai ranks hotels. See the summary at left for the supporting numbers. Among AI answers where hotel ranking could be measured, The Westin Grand München appeared in the Top 3 90.9% of the time, showing how prominently it is positioned when AI includes it.

The main opportunity is consistency: the hotel is already relevant across many traveler needs, so the next focus is understanding where it is absent from individual AI results. No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet, so change over time is not shown.

sections.headline: The Westin Grand München's most important issue is competitive displacement by Hotel Bayerischer Hof relative to other observed alternatives, not a vague visibility problem.
sections.keyInsight: Hotel Bayerischer Hof appears in 22 monitored scenarios where The Westin Grand München is absent. That observed scenario count is large enough to prioritize as a displacement lead versus a long undifferentiated competitor list. Related Reality Gap pressure includes Large Ballroom at 1.6% recognition, which may help explain why the hotel is not carried into those answers.
sections.whyItMatters: Leadership needs to understand why specific alternatives are surfaced instead of The Westin Grand München in the demand contexts where displacement is observed. Otherwise attention may stay on average scores while missing the leading substitution lead. Observational displacement is not the same as proven causality.
sections.focusNow: Focus first on the demand contexts where Hotel Bayerischer Hof is observed when The Westin Grand München is absent. Determine whether the relevant attributes and use cases are clearly represented across priority sources, without assuming the rival causes the miss.
sections.whatToReview: Open the underlying displacement evidence for Hotel Bayerischer Hof and compare attributes cited in those answers with The Westin Grand München's first-party and major travel-source representation. Confirm whether the same cues appear when the hotel is present. Do not infer causation from co-occurrence alone.
